description:
AI CRM that reasons for every user. Build audiences, draft campaigns and track results in ChatGPT.

Plotline is the AI customer engagement platform that reasons for every user. Its AI Director reads each user's full live context and decides the right channel, message, format and moment for them, or whether to reach out at all. You set the goal, guardrails and brand voice. Plotline gives every user their own AI marketer across in-app nudges, widgets, gamification, videos, push and email.

With the Plotline connector, you can run Plotline from ChatGPT in plain English, without logging into the dashboard:

- Audiences: preview audience size and create or update segments.
- Campaigns: pick from hundreds of templates, preview them and create draft campaigns. Drafts are never published automatically. You review and launch them in Plotline.
- Performance: list and search campaigns and get impressions, clicks and conversions.
- Feedback: pull survey responses and summarize themes.
- Assets: upload and manage images and media.
- Users and team: look up a user's profile and attributes, and list team members.
- Docs: get answers about SDK setup and features.

Access uses your Plotline login and follows your existing dashboard permissions.

defaultPrompt: Set up an AI Director objective to get new users to their first deposit within 7 days
How did my campaigns perform over the last 30 days? Show the top 5 by conversions.
Create an AI Signal that asks "How likely is this user to make their first deposit this week?"
